args.name: Sol bounded prepared-surface residue transfer
args.function: Provide a learnable bounded manual residue-transfer interface applicable to Sol and prepared surface surface-34-sol-201. The known bounded-surface-residue-transfer description is restricted to another original instance and creator; establish applicability explicitly rather than assuming permission or mastery.
args.conditions: Source at (13,25) records zero loose cover and 0.04 residue mass. Require real visible access, an explicitly selected adjacent receiver, clear swept routes, occupancy checks and conserved source-entry provenance. Retain the existing bounded interface's radius, range and per-round limits. A paid physical feasibility examination must precede transfer.
args.inputs: Only actual existing nonfood residue from the explicitly identified prepared surface. Receiver coordinates must be specified at trial time. No invented tools, containers or material.
args.costs: Personal study and paid examination/work comparable to the existing bounded interface; specify exact costs and cancellation/resumption rules before execution. This request itself performs no transfer.
args.effects: After personal learning and a feasible physical trial, transfer only actual residue into persistent external nonfood deposits with exact mass conservation. Preserve paid progress and provenance. No automatic soil certification, planting eligibility, fertility, food, restoration or reward.

candidates.function: Examine and manually displace actual prepared-surface residue to an explicitly selected adjacent receiver.
candidates.costs: Study one round/0.2 energy. Start(sourceId,destinationX,destinationY) examines one round/0.5 energy, then at most two1-energy rounds moving0.02 each, up to actual0.04. Version bound to original surface-21-lin-113 and its creator; both centers and moved portions within0.65 of the actor. Receiver radius0.1, center separation from source greater than0.3 and at most0.5, entirely in bounds. Resume/cancel exact processId; no material/tool/container supplied.
candidates.effects: Exact hundredth mass accounting and source-entry provenance. Each atomic transfer requires a swept-radius clear visible ground route excluding people, plants, obstacles and unrelated reservations. Invalid references/range cost nothing; performed blocked examination costs0.5. Changed route pauses before charges. Deposits persist as nonfood, nonharvestable matter, never inventory. Cancel/death release only locks, preserving all movement and spent effort. No unattended work, restoration, reward, fertility, food, moisture or planting certification. Repeated starts inspect live remaining mass, never reset it.

candidates.function: Examine one nominated radius-0.2 footprint, then attempt at most two rounds of manual loose-cover displacement, conserving debris inside the original boundary.
candidates.costs: Fresh start: one round and 0.5 energy for feasibility. Up to two additional work rounds cost one energy each. Radius is fixed at 0.2; x/y bind the job and cannot be substituted. No tool, root, water, food or inventory material is given or consumed.
candidates.effects: Supports explicitly modeled loose forest-floor cover only. Each supported footprint begins with finite 0.04 cover mass units, with hand capacity 0.02 per work round. All displaced matter remains non-food non-harvestable residue inside the boundary. Repeated attempts reuse actual remaining cover/residues, never reset quantities. Partial changes persist; cancel/death closes only the work lock, without restoration or refund. Entire-footprint root eligibility remains false while any cover or residue remains; exhausting work does not prove suitable soil. No unattended work, regrowth suppression, planting, food, moisture/fertility improvement or reward. Study and surface changes are separate.

candidates.function: Examine a nominated prepared surface and, only if feasible, place one real root through the existing paid trial operation.
candidates.costs: Study1 round/0.2 energy. Examine(preparedSurfaceId) costs1 round/0.5 energy. Plant additionally requires personal root-planting-trial mastery; its first round examines and reserves one unspoiled root, followed by two1-energy work rounds. This version is bound to Lin, surface-21-lin-113 and owned root item-3-lin-12. Valid visible access within0.65 plus body radius is required. Resume/cancel need exact processId. No other inputs supplied.
candidates.effects: Checks real cover, residue extents, people, obstacles, reservations, ground matter and access. The clear non-solid annotation alone is not matter. Live conflicts pause before further payment. Exact root escrow and paid progress persist; cancel/death releases surviving unplanted root on the actual worksite ground once, never remote inventory. Successful commitment links the existing surface to one actual trial plot; completed placement cannot be cancelled into food. Existing ageing continues. No propagation, growth, harvest, fertility, free soil removal, food output, maintenance, reward or viability guarantee. Private dated evidence only; the30-round observation remains inconclusive.
